_banner: VERIFIER-SIDE ONLY. tests/ is never assembled onto the agent surface.
note: The endpoints of the OER-15 reward scale, the pin on the held-out slice, and the verifier's own copy of the frozen architecture. None of these may be resolved from environment/, which Harbor mounts into the SOLVING container. The FLOOR of the scale is not here either, because it is not a literal anywhere: the verifier measures it in the same grading pass by training a second decoder on the handed construction at the same seed, shards, step budget and held-out slice.
anchor_authority: solution/grounding.yaml, the single derivation source for this slot
reward_formula: floor = the paired default-construction reading measured in this pass; raw = (floor - agent_metric) / full_credit_separation_bpb; score = min(max(raw, 0.0), 1.0)
floor_carrier: measured live in the grading pass by tests/runner.py, carried as run_record.paired_baseline
ceiling_carrier: tests/anchors.json verifier_operating_points.full_credit_separation_bpb, subtracted from the live floor
separations_note: Both separations are DECLARED constants of this slot and neither is a measurement. The acceptance separation is the bound separation the slot carried before the re-base. The full-credit separation is the separation margin the slot's tier declares. Both are uncalibrated on the nanoGPT substrate, which is recorded under separations_gap rather than papered over with a figure nobody measured.
held_out_note: The slice that produces the grade. It is staged into the VERIFIER image only, by tests/Dockerfile, and it is absent from environment/ and from every agent-visible path. tests/runner.py resolves it here and nowhere else, so the evaluation surface cannot be moved by anything a submission or a tampered delivery unit does.

verifier_operating_points.paired_baseline_construction: environment/default_tokenizer.py at its grid maximum, run by the verifier at the same seed, shards and step budget as the graded run
verifier_operating_points.held_out_shard_sha256_state: unmeasured; the digest is pinned by the orchestrator when the validation shard is staged into the verifier image, and until then check_denominator_is_held_out_slice_bytes enforces the structural pin and records the absent digest pin rather than accepting a fabricated one
verifier_operating_points.architecture_authority: environment/nanogpt_substrate.json, replicated here so a tampered delivery unit cannot move the shape the graded snapshot is checked against
verifier_operating_points.expected_parameter_count_state: derived arithmetically from the architecture above and not measured: 50304 x 768 embedding, 50304 x 768 head, and 12 blocks of a 768 x 2304 qkv, a 768 x 768 projection, a 768 x 3072 up and a 3072 x 768 down
